entities.summary: Krithi Karanth is the Chief Conservation Scientist and Director at the Centre for Wildlife Studies (CWS), Bangalore, India and an Adjunct faculty member of the Nicholas School at Duke University in the United States and the National Centre for Biological Sciences in India.
